svg.title: dsh-tender-requirements structure: two readers, a nine-item grid and six wording families, two evidence gates, and the A/B/C queue scoreboard above a ten-cell coverage net
svg.desc: A .docx is read twice: every table through allTablesOf and the paragraphs through ingestDocx. The table channel keeps exactly two-column tables and yields six front-appendix key rows for the nine-item grid (6 of 9 retrieved) plus the composition list and copy counts. The paragraph channel splits sentences into six rejection families. A clause passes gate one only when it is verbatim and unhedged; gate two decides A when it sits in a binding section, otherwise B. Hedged or unlocated clauses go to C. Front-appendix keys bypass both gates into A. The run gives A 8, B 2, C 1; because C is non-empty deliverable is false. The COV-01 to COV-10 ribbon reports 6 hit and 4 miss, and a miss means not retrieved, never absent.
